appointmentNumber.title: Appointment Number
appointmentNumber.description: Confirmation number of the appointment to move.

callbackPhone.title: Callback Phone
callbackPhone.description: The phone number the appointment was booked under. Required: no windows are returned unless its last four digits match the record.

preferredTimeframe.title: Preferred Timeframe
preferredTimeframe.description: Any preference the caller mentioned, such as mornings, next week, or Friday.
